commit_message_on_validation:
Section 7 is split between the machines on snapshot 438e812:
- x86_64: fmt, clippy, tests (debug and release), release build, demo.
- ARM64 VM: native-diff. Level 1, level 2 rust (651 of 674, the 23
  refused programs as before) and the level 3 demo pass. Level 3 golden
  is NOT_RUN because the VM has no captures. 420 routines, the generated
  code is clippy clean, and the corpus is 76.4% native.
- Level 2 auto failed once on change_a_physical_file_with_a_logical_file_over_it.
  It is a CL and CHGPF test with no RPG, and it is known to break on
  QTEMP rows left by interrupted runs. It passed when rerun alone (auto
  and interp). The whole suite under auto on a new database then gave
  673 passed and 0 failed (log sha256 729d3217...).
